setup.title: Who is this for?
setup.subtitle: We will show the trackers that fit you. You can change this any time in Settings.

women.title: Women's health
women.description: Cycle, pregnancy, water, mood and nutrition

setup.privacy: Saved only on this device. It is used only to choose which trackers you see.

myTrackers.title: My trackers
myTrackers.emptyMessage: Turn on trackers in Settings to see them here.

install.title: Install the app
install.description: Add Wellness to your home screen or desktop. It opens like an app and works offline.
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.subtitle: Here is how we handle your health information.
privacy.device: Everything is stored on this device first. The app works fully without an account.
privacy.account: An account is optional. It backs up your data, protected so only you can read it.
privacy.noAds: We never sell your data or use it for advertising. There are no ad trackers in the app.
privacy.control: You can export or permanently delete all your data at any time from Settings.

consent.title: Choose what to track
consent.subtitle: Each kind of health data needs your permission. Turn on only what you want. You can change this later in Settings.

notifications.title: Reminders, only if you want them
notifications.subtitle: Everything is off. Turn on what would help. We only ask your device for permission when you first set a reminder.
notifications.lockScreen: Hidden on the lock screen by default; reminders never mention health details.

water.title: Water intake
water.why: Amounts and times you log, to show your daily progress.

mood.title: Mood and journal
mood.why: Mood check-ins and journal entries, to show your monthly insights.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.why: Bed and wake times, to show your sleep patterns.

cycle.title: Period and cycle
cycle.why: Period dates, flow and symptoms, to estimate your next cycle.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy
pregnancy.why: Due date, appointments, kicks and weight, to follow your pregnancy week by week.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.why: Meals and foods you log, to show balanced nutrition summaries.

anonymous_analytics.title: Anonymous usage statistics
anonymous_analytics.why: Counts such as which screens are opened. Never includes health details.

consent.gateMessage: To use this tracker we need your permission to store this information.

scheduled.title: Reminders
scheduled.why: At times you choose, like drinking water or a mood check-in.

smart.title: Smart timing
smart.why: Water reminders spread across your waking hours, which wait after a drink and stop once you reach your goal.

achievement.title: Achievements
achievement.why: A note when you reach a milestone. Sent once per achievement.

requirement.title: Missing information
requirement.why: At most once a week, if a tracker needs something from you.

insight.title: Weekly summary
insight.why: A short summary of your week and gentle trends.

account.title: Account
account.optional: Optional. Back up your data and use it on more than one device.
account.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
account.resetMessage: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
account.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
account.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
account.notConfigured: Accounts are not available in this version.

dataControls.title: Your data
dataControls.deleteMessage: This permanently deletes everything on this device, cancels all reminders and, if you are signed in, deletes your account and all data stored in it. This cannot be undone.
dataControls.deleteExportFirst: You may want to export your data first.
dataControls.deleteFailed: We could not delete your account. Nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again.

prefs.masterHint: Everything stays off until you turn it on, and you choose each type below.

prefs.privacyHint: Notifications only say “Time for your check-in”, never details.
prefs.systemHint: Account and security messages. They can't be turned off and appear in the notification center.
prefs.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your device settings.
prefs.webNote: In the web app, reminders and badges appear in the notification center. Device notifications are available in the Android and iOS apps.

waterGoal.title: Set your daily water goal
waterGoal.why: Your goal lets the Water tracker show your progress and spread reminders through the day.
waterGoal.label: Daily goal ({{unit}})
waterGoal.guidance: The NHS suggests about 6 to 8 glasses of fluid a day. Needs vary with climate, activity, pregnancy and health, so ask a healthcare professional if you're unsure.
waterGoal.source: Source: NHS, “Water, drinks and your health”.

lastPeriod.title: Add the start of your last period
lastPeriod.why: Cycle estimates start from this date. It stays private, and you can change it at any time.
lastPeriod.label: First day of your last period ({{pattern}})

dueDate.title: Add your due date
dueDate.why: Your due date sets the week-by-week content and your appointment timeline.
dueDate.label: Estimated due date ({{pattern}})
dueDate.guidance: Your doctor or midwife can confirm your due date, usually from an early scan.

water.subtitle: Every drink counts toward your day
water.noGoal: Set a goal to see your progress
water.customError: Enter an amount up to 5 litres
water.chartSummary: Last {{days}} days: {{logged}} days logged, {{average}} on average on those days

smart.title: Smart reminders
smart.description: Spread across your waking hours. They wait an hour after a drink and stop once you reach your goal.
smart.needsPermission: To receive them, turn on notifications and the Smart timing type in notification settings.

checkIn.title: How are you feeling?
checkIn.notePrivate: Private to you. Never used for ads.

insights.title: {{month}}
insights.empty: Your month will fill in as you check in.
insights.patternsNote: These are patterns in what you logged, not causes or a diagnosis.

breathe.title: Breathe

patternHints.box: Breathe in, hold, out and hold for 4 seconds each.
patternHints.relax478: In for 4, hold for 7, out slowly for 8.
patternHints.calm: In for 5 and out for 5, with no holds.

breathe.safety: Breathe gently. If you feel dizzy or unwell, stop and breathe normally.

journal.title: Journal

prompts.energy: What gave you energy today, and what took it away?

support.title: Support is available
support.message: If you are struggling or thinking about harming yourself, you don't have to go through it alone. These free, confidential lines are open 24 hours a day.
support.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call 112 in India or 911 in the USA.

teleManas.name: Tele-MANAS (India)
teleManas.detail: National mental health helpline, 14416 or 1-800-891-4416, in many Indian languages.

lifeline988.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (USA)
lifeline988.detail: Call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org.
